title: Audioman EQ Profile Result
description: Output envelope for `audioman eq-profile --json`. Reports one entry per executed analysis mode (response, sweep, nonlinear); a mode that fails stores {"error": "..."} instead of its measurement result. Mode keys are modelled via additionalProperties.

additionalProperties.description: One executed analysis mode: response ({params, magnitude_range_db, is_minimum_phase, thd_at_1k, fft_size}), sweep ({n_settings, measurements}) or nonlinear ({n_levels, levels_db, thd_per_level, is_level_dependent, max_response_deviation_db}); {"error": ...} on failure.
